audit.why: TRICKY 7.5/10 is what the page carries and the mirror (quinn__shen) left difficulty framing intact; the whys describe Quinn controlling most of lane.
audit.corrected: Difficulty unchanged. The tension between a 56.64% Shen win rate and a Quinn-dominant chart is recorded in questionsForUser rather than silently resolved.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows said Skill/Shen while their own why text describes Quinn winning, and they disagree with the already-audited mirror.
audit.why: packet.levelChart gives Quinn rows 0-5. The mirror flipped rows 1, 2, 3 and 5 to Quinn in both layers and deliberately kept row 6 on Shen (whys[6], spikes[3] and late all describe Shen reclaiming it). Matching that here keeps the two pages from rendering opposite answers.
audit.corrected: phases[1|2|3|5].side and win[1|2|3|5] to Quinn as one atomic group, with Shen-side ratings dropped to match. Row 6 left on Shen, matching the mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: Quinn's R was called 'Behind the Scenes' in two places, and the Vault-interrupts-Stand-United interaction was never stated.
audit.why: Her R is Behind Enemy Lines. Vault (675 range, 12/11/10/9/8s) 'briefly interrupts' its target on the leap-off, which cancels Shen's R channel — Stand United is a channel on a 200/180/160s cooldown, so one Vault costs the whole ult.
audit.corrected: Name fixed in whys[4] and late; the Vault-cancels-your-R warning added to spikes[2] and late with the real range and cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[1] said 'only engage if Vault is clearly on cooldown' without the number.
audit.why: Vault is 12/11/10/9/8s, so the punish window is concrete and short.
audit.corrected: whys[1] now names the 12-second window at rank 1.

edits.before: She picks up Vault (E) at level 2 and can now knock you back mid-Shadow-Dash, interrupting your taunt entirely — only engage if Vault is clearly on cooldown.
edits.after: She picks up Vault (E) at level 2 and can now knock you back mid-Shadow-Dash, interrupting your taunt entirely — only engage inside its 12-second window.

edits.before: Stand United comes online but Quinn's Behind the Scenes (R) gives her equal roaming speed, so your global advantage is real but not uncontested — watch the minimap.
edits.after: Stand United comes online but Quinn's Behind Enemy Lines (R) gives her equal roaming speed, so your global advantage is real but not uncontested — watch the minimap.

edits.before: Stand United comes online — even if you never win this lane, you can now concede it entirely and save a collapsing teamfight anywhere on the map.
edits.after: Stand United lets you concede the lane and save a collapsing fight anywhere — but channel it outside Vault range, because her knock-off interrupts it.

edits.before: With Sunfire Aegis and a second tank item, your raw durability outpaces Quinn's poke output significantly — she can no longer chip you to half HP in three autos and a blind bolt. The 1v1 is genuinely competitive when Vault is down: E in along a wall to minimise the window she has to react, W the Harrier-empowered auto, then Q through the blade for the full shred hit. Quinn's danger in the late game is not the 1v1 but her roaming: Behind the Scenes (R) lets her cross the map as fast as your Stand United, so track her on the minimap every time she shoves the wave. Your role is frontline engage and Stand United impact — land your E on their carry in fights, not on Quinn, and win the game through teamfight presence rather than a side-lane duel.
edits.after: With Sunfire Aegis and a second tank item, your raw durability outpaces Quinn's poke output significantly — she can no longer chip you to half HP in three autos and a blind bolt. The 1v1 is genuinely competitive when Vault is down: E in along a wall to minimise the window she has to react, W the Harrier-empowered auto, then Q through the blade for the full shred hit. Quinn's danger in the late game is not the 1v1 but her roaming: Behind Enemy Lines (R) lets her cross the map as fast as your Stand United, so track her on the minimap every time she shoves the wave. Never channel Stand United within 675 range of her — Vault's knock-off interrupts it and burns the full 160-second cooldown. In fights, land E on their carry, not on Quinn.

notes: 'Behind the Scenes' is not a Quinn ability — her R is Behind Enemy Lines; it appeared in whys[4] and late. packet.suspectNames flagged wants.you[1] 'Use Spirit's Refuge' — FALSE POSITIVE, the leading 'Use ' produced the near-miss distance.
